spec.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
taskFacts: Given the root of a binary search tree and two distinct nodes p and q that are both in it, return their lowest shared ancestor node.
A node counts as its own descendant, so p or q may be the answer. Node values are unique and obey the BST ordering rule.
constraints: p and q both exist in the BST.

examples.explanation: Both requested nodes lie beneath node 2.
One requested node is an ancestor of the other.
